name: Someya Yuzu
source: The childhood friend of Seichi, Koiken Otome's protagonist. Since she herself is rather weak, she desires nothing more than to help others to reach their absolute best. [Spoiler]This leads to self-esteem issues that come into play during her route.[/Spoiler]
